caption: The drawing depicts a single stone object composed of two main geometric elements: a rectangular block and an attached hemispherical basin. The rectangular block serves as the base and extends horizontally, with a textured surface suggesting a rough, stone-like material. The attached basin is set into the left side of the block and is rounded, with a smooth, bowl-shaped interior and a slight lip at its edge, as well as a pedestal below. The object is colored in various shades of beige, tan, and light brown, with subtle variations indicating light and shadow as well as the natural texture of stone. The background is plain and uncolored, with no additional objects or features present. The name "ROSE CAMPBELL GERKE" is written in small capital letters in fine print near the lower right corner of the image.
title: Carved Stone Wash Basin
